messages.subject: RStan 1.0.2 OK with cov_matrix indexing
parts:
On 10/17/12 3:09 AM, Guy Freeman wrote:

> Has this bug been fixed? I downloaded and installed rstan version
> 1.0.2 but I came across the same error.

Yes, the bug's been fixed. I just tested in the
release version of 1.0.2.

Are you sure you have rstan 1.0.2 installed? Try

> stan_version()
[1] "1.0.2"

If it's not 1.0.2, follow the instructions here to
reinstall:

http://code.google.com/p/stan/wiki/RStanGettingStarted

You may need to restart R.

- Bob
